package_structure.vcf_parser/_writer.py: VcfWriter — header/body/trailer serialization, VcfLayer, encode_geometry_element, encode_circle_element, GEOMETRY_HEADER_TEMPLATE
package_structure.vcf_parser/_reader.py: extract_active_layers_details(), backward scan, color/cutter/direction maps, GEOMETRY_SIG
package_structure.vcf_compiler_map_config.json: ACI color → VCF parameter mapping config (10+ colors with validation statuses)

features: Header with magic (1.0.012/1.0.013) + 0x13 prefix + stock dims
8B trailers (output_flag + color) on empty blocks for backward scan
Layer block: output_flag@0, speed@4, cutter@32, color@76, h1@80, feed@88, h2@96, dir@104, ext@114/122
is_closed with 0.001 epsilon (fixes floating point drift)
not_implemented: Full 472B machine profile header (uses native template as workaround)

features: Color from trailer at pos-4 (previous block's last 4 bytes)
Layer extraction: speed validation, color, cutter, h1, h2, feed, output_flag
Color name mapping (14 known + custom fallback)

test_files: tests/test_writer_unit.py — 25 tests (layer block, geometry, circle, header, trailer, roundtrip)
tests/test_roundtrip.py — 5 tests (known files, synthetic line, two layers, V-slot, determinism)

key_findings: b2b reader != VCutWorks rendering engine (first working VCF had 0 layers in b2b)
Native header is always 472 B (machine profile) — identical across all native VCFs
Hybrid VCF (native header + our payload) shows layer cards but NO geometry
Bytes 12-44 in geometry element are const template from native — zeros cause invisible geometry
is_closed fails on FP drift (2.27e-13) — fixed with epsilon comparison
encode_circle_element was dead code with wrong pt_count — now produces 4 arc segments
pending_tasks: GUI validation of hybrid VCFs (after a1b339c fix)
Implement 472B machine profile header template in writer
Write geometry header byte analysis (understand bytes 12-44 meaning)
decisions_made: ACI 7 → RGB(0,0,0) not white (VCutWorks palette != AutoCAD)
GEOMETRY_HEADER_TEMPLATE = hardcoded from native (unknown meaning, but functional)
encode_circle_element pt_count=4 with arc segments (matching native sub=3 format)
open_questions: What do bytes 12-44 in geometry header actually represent?
Why does empty_canavas have different structure (no 257×610 blocks)?
Will VCutWorks accept fully synthetic VCF with template bytes but without machine profile header?
